cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: One Thing Leads to Another
cards.instruction: Use each small problem to justify solving a broader, more disruptive problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The tap drips. Time to replace the sink. I taught you to look beyond the obvious fault.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It needs a washer. I've already bought one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good beginner diagnosis. We'll fit it when the sink's out, then replace that swollen worktop. You used to stop after the easy part.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The worktop runs under every cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There, you're finally following the problem. Empty the cupboards; we'll move them and fix the whole kitchen layout. I'll show you where to start.

reason: Replace detachable teacher prefixes with corrections and influence claims that materially shape the specific pursuit, keeping B contributions causal.
